title: Value Line Manual Band Saws, 10″ to 15-3/4″ (NT-M series) | NovoTech Canada
meta_description: NovoTech value-line manual gravity-feed band saws in Canada: NT-M 10 series (mitre vise, swivel bow, hydraulic down-feed, twin-mitre) and the Ø15-3/4″ NT-M 16. Value line with CSA panels, parts and support in Mississauga.
intro: NovoTech's own value line of gravity-feed pivot saws: the bow descends on a hydraulic damper with adjustable feed pressure, a belt or gear drive gives several blade speeds, and every model ships with a coolant pump and a stop rod. Four 10-inch models cover mitre-vise, swivel-bow, hydraulic-damped and twin-mitre cutting; the NT-M 16 handles 15-3/4″ rounds with a gear drive and carbide guides.
hero_points: Hydraulic-damped descent with adjustable feed pressure
Swivel and twin-mitre bows for angle cuts to 60°
Round capacities from Ø10″ (254 mm) to Ø15-3/4″ (400 mm)
hero_brand_line: NovoTech's own brand: manufactured in China to high North American quality standards, with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and Mississauga, Ontario parts and support as every machine we sell.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoTech manual band saws

faq.q: What is the difference between the NT-M 10, 10 S, 10 D and 10 T?
faq.a: All four are 10-inch gravity-feed saws with the same 2 HP motor. The NT-M 10 cuts angles with a mitre vise, the NT-M 10 S has a bow that swivels 45°–90°, the NT-M 10 D has a larger frame (18″ wide stock) with hydraulic down-feed control, and the NT-M 10 T swivels both ways — 45° left and right, 60° right.

faq.q: How does the value line differ from the Bekamak premium line?
faq.a: Value-line saws are proven designs built to NovoTech's specification at a lower price; Bekamak saws are built in Turkey with European components and heavier construction. Both come with a CSA-approved electrical panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from Mississauga. Compare the Bekamak manual band saws.

faq.q: When should I move up to a hydraulic (semi-automatic) saw?
faq.a: When you cut more than a few dozen pieces a day, or when the operator is tied up holding the bow. The NT-H series clamps hydraulically, cuts at a preset feed and lifts the bow by itself — see the value line semi-automatic band saws.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
